what: Results regenerated with the corrected simulation engine (same scenarios, same seeds as the published set).

physics_models.leo_slant_rain: gamma * h_rain / sin(el); no P.618 reduction factors
physics_models.orbit: circular, spherical Earth, no J2, no Earth rotation in pass timing
physics_models.rain_specific_attenuation: ITU-R P.838-3 analytic fit (1-100 GHz), pure H polarization, theta=0
physics_models.terrestrial_distance_factor: ITU-R P.530-18 form (P.530-19 not adopted; see docs/LIMITATIONS.md)

differences_vs_published: rain model: ITU-R P.838-3 analytic fit (published set: superseded P.838-0/-1 table)
data-quality gate: newly seen serving contexts learn a baseline from their first 20 valid samples
evidence-based VERIFY (serving-context aware, ATPC-masking aware); new columns first_action, verify_outcome_first, verified_first, verify_outcome_escalation, verified_escalation
new columns t_decision_layer_escalation and escalation_window_min (like-for-like window)
coverage_comparison.csv: two added LEO capacity-bound rows; microwave hop 18.32 -> 16.21 km
not_included: decision-layer parameters and scenario definitions are deliberately not part of this record
